verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents building multi-step automations visually or in code that run in cloud Chromium. Its agents navigate unseen sites autonomously from a natural-language goal and handle logins, 2FA and CAPTCHAs on their own, which is what unattended runs require. Every run is captured with recordings and reasoning for later review. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron or trigger documentation for background execution (only a bare 'Connect to Zapier' mention), and independent corroboration of reliable unattended runs, since one hands-on report shows the agent failing off the happy path.
